amount_notes: Up to $15,000 per 4-6 month internship unit. Business contributes minimum $7,500, Mitacs matches with $7,500. Cluster stream available for 6+ internship units from 3+ interns for additional funding. Limited funding available in Alberta for 2025-2026 fiscal year.
organization_types_eligible: Not-for-profit corporations in Canada (must demonstrate economic or productivity orientation)
eligibility_criteria: Must be incorporated for-profit or NFP corporation, municipality, or hospital operating in Canada
Project must involve collaboration with an eligible Canadian academic institution and support R&D objectives
NFP organizations must demonstrate economic or productivity orientation in project
Must contribute minimum $7,500 per internship unit as partner contribution
Intern must be registered student, postdoc, or recent graduate within 2 years at a Canadian academic institution
exclusions: Mitacs funds cannot be matched by any other federal or provincial agency
Routine development without research component does not qualify
Alberta and Saskatchewan have limited funding available for 2025-2026 fiscal year — confirm availability with Mitacs advisor before applying
Interns may not participate in more than one internship simultaneously
notes: IMPORTANT FOR SK CLIENTS: Limited funding available in Saskatchewan for 2025-2026 fiscal year. Confirm availability with local Mitacs advisor before recommending. Rolling intake, 6-8 week review. NFPs eligible if project demonstrates economic or productivity orientation. Indigenous Pathways initiative cap increased from 12 to 30 internship units per submission year as of December 15 2025 — relevant for Indigenous-led organizations. Requires academic institution partner — client must identify a university or college collaborator before applying. Good fit for Sacral Solutions if they have an R&D component.
